storyCards.headline: Roll To Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Del Amitri's "Roll To Me" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Roll to Me" is a song by Scottish pop rock band Del Amitri, released in June 1995 by A&M Records as the third single from their fourth studio album, Twisted (1995).

The song became their biggest hit in the United States when it reached number 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.

It finished at number 55 on the Billboard Year-End Hot 100 singles chart of 1995.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.
